neighbours.label: the wrongful or stubborn course of action in a warning that it will not pay off ('you never get anywhere by cheating', 'nobody got rich by stealing', 'he won't get far if he persists'); honest means in the same frame stay quiet
fire: My grandfather always said you never win anything lasting by cheating at cards.
No shopkeeper ever built a loyal clientele by stealing from customers.
The coach told them they would gain nothing in the long run by cheating the referee.
Our mayor will not get much further if he persists with this reckless plan.
A student rarely learns anything useful by cheating on homework.
In the end nobody stays wealthy for long by stealing from partners.
People seldom get what they really want by lying to their friends.
The firm won't keep its clients for long if it persists in overcharging them.
quiet: My grandfather always said you win lasting friends by playing cards fairly.
No shopkeeper ever built a loyal clientele without greeting customers.
The coach told them they would gain a lot in the long run by training daily.
Our mayor will get much further if he listens to the council.
A student usually learns something useful by reading on weekends.
In the end nobody stays wealthy for long without saving regularly.
People often get what they really want by asking their friends.
The firm will keep its clients for long if it answers them promptly.

notes: Card: 'rather than trying to force', 'why their punishment isn't working', 'never get anything good by cheating', 'won't get far if he persists'. Probes: by cheating 0.90, by stealing 0.54, won't get you anywhere 0.42, persists 0.37; by working hard 0.02, by yelling 0.05, by flattering 0.09. Only partly a meaning: cheating/stealing dominate.
